summary: Fixes a second latent root-ownership bug r0031 surfaced: validate_phase_d_component (used by capture/attach/restore) always enforced live root-ownership on a captured artifact's own signer directory, which legitimately sits in ordinary /tmp staging. Adds parse_trust_policy_dict_for_recovery_artifact as a separate, explicit entry point; parse_trust_policy_dict (live installed state, the real supervisor's own check) is unchanged. No protected-runtime change; no supervisor re-stage needed.
